decisions.reason: The hearty loaf has been part of the core bread range since 2018, so the bakery has invested in it and committed to it, and it fits a traditional assortment that management will want to justify continuing.

The sweet pastry has no reported results, but it has been on the website for several years, and a bakery tends to keep such items as part of its everyday range rather than admit the launch was a mistake.
The crusty farmhouse bread fits the firm's announced traditional, mill-based bakery identity, so management is likely to hold on to it even with no visible results.
The poppy seed stollen won a gold award and was publicly showcased on a page of its own, so the firm is strongly committed to it and is very likely to keep it as a seasonal flagship.
The gold-awarded premium stollen is a visible marker of the firm's quality claims, which makes dropping it very unlikely.
